config sysname wlc1
config snmp community create <secret removed>
config radius auth add 1 192.0.2.10 1812 ascii <secret removed>
config wlan create 1 corp corp
config wlan security wpa akm psk set-key ascii <secret removed> 1
config wlan enable 1
